name: CS2KZ · Steam Runtime 3
author: replace-me@example.com
description: CS2KZ on Sniper with optional companion plugins, pinning and persistent configuration. Generate this egg with manage.py egg before importing. Uses the pterodactyl target of the shared Dockerfile.

installation.script:
set -eu
export HOME=/mnt/server
export SERVER_DIR=/mnt/server
export STATE_DIR=/mnt/server/.cs2kz/state
export CONFIG_DIR=/mnt/server/.cs2kz/config
export STEAMCMD_DIR=/mnt/server/.cs2kz/steamcmd
export PTERODACTYL=1
python3 /opt/cs2kz/pterodactyl.py --install

variables.name: Steam login token
variables.description: App 730 GSLT. Blank preserves server-private.cfg.

variables.name: RCON password
variables.description: Blank preserves the generated password. Only letters, digits, hyphens and underscores.

variables.name: Update CS2
variables.description: 1 updates on startup; 0 freezes an existing installation. Blank uses settings.json.

variables.name: Validate CS2
variables.description: 1 validates game files when updating. Blank uses settings.json.

variables.name: Steam branch
variables.description: Blank uses settings.json; default is public.

variables.name: Required Steam build
variables.description: An installed build to require. Set CS2_UPDATE to 0 and restore matching files first.

variables.name: Initial map
variables.description: Built-in map. Blank uses settings.json.

variables.name: Workshop map
variables.description: Workshop map ID; overrides the built-in map. Blank uses settings.json.

variables.name: Player slots
variables.description: Blank uses settings.json; default is 16.

variables.name: Maintenance interval
variables.description: Hours between maintenance restarts. New panel installations default to 0; use panel schedules or opt in here.

variables.name: Maintenance warning
variables.description: Seconds of in-game warning before maintenance. Blank uses settings.json.

variables.name: metamod version
variables.description: latest or a fixed release version. Blank uses settings.json.

variables.name: metamod checksum
variables.description: Optional pinned archive SHA256. Blank uses settings.json. Requires a fixed component version.

variables.description: latest or a fixed release version. Blank uses settings.json.
